items.label: Schneier on Security
items.title: Recent Outages Have Economic Causes
items.summary: This essay originally appeared in The Guardian . It’s an expanded version of the one I posted as “ We Get the Infrastructure We Pay For .” It’s been a bad week for our computerized infrastructure. We’ve seen outages at Microsoft , the FAA , a handful of banks , United Airlines , an unnamed classified NSA network , and Apple . People should be forgiven for suspecting a coordinated cyberattack, a common cause, or at least a conspiracy. But there is none. The incidents are unrelated. They’re not the result of any cyberattack, coordinated or not. And, even more surprising, they don’t seem to be...
